title: [poll] How much of a RAG monthly bill is generation tokens?
body:
> **Calibration poll.** Guess before you read [The Cost Iceberg](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/60-cheatsheets/frameworks/cost-iceberg.md).

A mid-size deployment: 2M chunks, 300k queries a month, self-hosted encoder, corpus churns 15% a
month, an in-VPC OpenSearch cluster.

**What share of the monthly bill is generation tokens?**

- **A** — about 80%. It is the expensive model call
- **B** — about 55%
- **C** — about 30%
- **D** — under 15%. The cluster dominates

### Why this is worth guessing first

Almost everyone quotes a per-query token cost when a client asks what the system costs. If your
guess is A or B, you would describe a minority of the bill with high confidence and imply the
rest is rounding — and that conversation goes badly in month three *because* your number was
accurate.
---

**How to vote.** The API cannot create a native poll widget, so vote with a reaction on this post — 👍 A · 🎉 B · 😄 C · 🚀 D — and reply if your answer needs a condition attached. The reveal is posted as a **reply** in about a week, never by editing this body: editing would destroy the record of what you were actually asked.
